name: Édar
text: Édar is a variant spelling of Étar, the Ulster king recorded in the lists of early Irish rulers. MacKillop reads the form as one of the attested renderings of the name. The principal record sits under Étar.

attributes.attribute: Variant spelling of Étar; pointer to Étar headword

okr.objective: Édar is a MacKillop signpost to Étar.
key_results: Cites Étar as the canonical headword.
Variant form of the Ulster king.
